responsibility: Declares the public interface and core data structures for GCC’s RTL common-subexpression/value-numbering library, including cselib_val, location and set records, recording-mode flags, lookup/expansion/substitution/invalidation APIs, preserved-value support, stack/CFA-related helpers, and dump hooks. This header is the contract consumed by passes such as DSE, CPROP, and other RTL optimizers that use cselib.cc’s value-tracking services.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public contract for the cselib library, while gcc/cselib.cc provides the executable implementation. Unlike the .cc file’s value-tracking and invalidation algorithms, this header mainly exposes the cselib_val-related data structures, option flags, inline helpers, hooks, and function prototypes used by other RTL optimization passes.
